answer: Trust spreads from verified seeds like a reef: each seed vouches for at most 4 newcomers per epoch, and trust halves every hop, dying after 3 hops, so distant endorsements never reach the core. Each newcomer posts a 2,000 POA bond, 25% burned on a failed audit. An attacker building a ridge of 100 fakes locks 200,000 POA to earn at most 400 POA each/epoch, a loss near 50x. Dormant trust, an ember, stays frozen until 5 clean epochs pass. Edge case: a seed goes rogue and vouches a sybil farm; cap each seed at 20 vouches per epoch and slash its bond 40% when over 10% of its vouchees fail audit.
